words.note: 用來直接引用某個人、機構或文件已明確說過的內容。
words.example: As stated by the report, demand increased significantly last year.
words.exampleZh: 根據報告所述，去年的需求顯著增加。

exercises.original: According to the report, the company reduced its costs last year.
exercises.upgrade: According to the report, the company reduced its costs last year.

options.explanation: 直接指出報告已明確陳述。

exercises.original: According to the official notice, the building will close at six.
exercises.upgrade: According to the official notice, the building will close at six.

words.note: 表示某個判斷、結論或決定建立在資料、證據或資訊之上。
words.example: Based on the survey results, most customers prefer the new design.
words.exampleZh: 根據調查結果，大多數顧客較喜歡新設計。

exercises.original: According to the survey results, most customers prefer the new design.
exercises.upgrade: According to the survey results, most customers prefer the new design.

options.explanation: 結論建立在調查資料上。
可用於報道來源，但這裡更偏數據依據。

exercises.original: According to the available evidence, the equipment failed because of overheating.
exercises.upgrade: According to the available evidence, the equipment failed because of overheating.

words.note: 用來引用新聞機構、記者、報告或其他報道來源。
words.example: As reported by local media, the road will reopen tomorrow.
words.exampleZh: 據當地媒體報道，該道路將於明天重開。

exercises.original: According to local media, the road will reopen tomorrow.
exercises.upgrade: According to local media, the road will reopen tomorrow.

exercises.original: According to the newspaper, the company plans to open another office.
exercises.upgrade: According to the newspaper, the company plans to open another office.

options.explanation: 新聞紙本身不是圖表證據。

words.note: 表示某個來源曾特別提到或指出某一點。
words.example: As noted by the researchers, the sample size was relatively small.
words.exampleZh: 正如研究人員指出，樣本數量相對較小。

exercises.original: According to the researchers, the sample was relatively small.
exercises.upgrade: According to the researchers, the sample was relatively small.

exercises.original: According to the review, several important limitations remain.
exercises.upgrade: According to the review, several important limitations remain.

words.meaning: 正如……所解釋；根據……的解釋
words.note: 用來引述某個來源對原因、機制或情況的解釋。
words.example: As explained by the engineer, the delay was caused by a technical fault.
words.exampleZh: 根據工程師的解釋，延誤是由技術故障造成的。

exercises.original: According to the engineer, the delay was caused by a technical fault.
exercises.upgrade: According to the engineer, the delay was caused by a technical fault.

options.explanation: 也可，但較少突出解釋者。

exercises.original: According to the doctor, the symptoms were caused by an allergic reaction.
exercises.upgrade: According to the doctor, the symptoms were caused by an allergic reaction.

options.explanation: 可在非常簡略醫療記錄中見到，但此處不如 explained 自然。

words.meaning: 根據……所顯示；正如……所表明
words.note: 表示資料、數據、跡象或證據顯示某個結果。
words.example: As indicated by the data, sales were strongest in the final quarter.
words.exampleZh: 根據數據顯示，第四季度的銷售最強。

exercises.original: According to the data, sales were highest in December.
exercises.upgrade: According to the data, sales were highest in December.

exercises.original: According to the test results, the new material is more durable.
exercises.upgrade: According to the test results, the new material is more durable.

options.explanation: 表示一致，不是證據來源。

words.note: 表示某個圖表、結果、例子或證據直接展示出某一點。
words.example: As shown by the chart, energy use fell steadily over five years.
words.exampleZh: 根據圖表顯示，能源使用量在五年間穩步下降。

exercises.original: According to the chart, energy use fell steadily.
exercises.upgrade: According to the chart, energy use fell steadily.

exercises.original: According to the graph, prices rose sharply after June.
exercises.upgrade: According to the graph, prices rose sharply after June.

words.note: 表示遵循規則、法律、程序、政策或正式要求。
words.example: The procedure was carried out in accordance with safety regulations.
words.exampleZh: 該程序依照安全規例進行。

exercises.original: According to safety regulations, all visitors must wear protective equipment.
exercises.upgrade: According to safety regulations, all visitors must wear protective equipment.

exercises.original: According to company policy, confidential files must be encrypted.
exercises.upgrade: According to company policy, confidential files must be encrypted.

words.note: 表示某個行動、政策或結果與某項標準、預期或原則一致。
words.example: The changes were made in line with the new guidelines.
words.exampleZh: 這些修改是按照新指引作出的。

exercises.original: According to the new guidelines, the application form has been simplified.
exercises.upgrade: According to the new guidelines, the application form has been simplified.

options.explanation: 若只是引用也可，但此處重點是符合指引。
可能表示原因，但少了「符合」意味。

exercises.original: According to current standards, the equipment must be inspected annually.
exercises.upgrade: According to current standards, the equipment must be inspected annually.

words.note: 在法律、規則、合約或制度語境中，可表示「根據某項規定」。
words.example: Under the new law, employers must provide additional safety training.
words.exampleZh: 根據新法律，僱主必須提供額外安全培訓。

exercises.original: According to the new law, employers must provide additional training.
exercises.upgrade: According to the new law, employers must provide additional training.

options.explanation: 法律語境非常自然、簡潔。

exercises.original: According to the contract, payment is due within thirty days.
exercises.upgrade: According to the contract, payment is due within thirty days.

words.note: 比 based on 更正式，強調判斷或決定的依據。
words.example: The decision was made on the basis of the available evidence.
words.exampleZh: 這項決定是根據現有證據作出的。

exercises.original: According to the available evidence, the committee rejected the claim.
exercises.upgrade: According to the available evidence, the committee rejected the claim.

exercises.original: According to the test scores, the students were placed into different groups.
exercises.upgrade: According to the test scores, the students were placed into different groups.

options.explanation: 分組決策建立在分數上。
雖可表示原因，但較不正式、較不精確。

words.note: 在某些報道、估計或分類結構中，可簡潔指出來源。
words.example: By the government's estimate, the project will cost $20 million.
words.exampleZh: 據政府估計，該項目將耗資二千萬元。

exercises.original: According to one estimate, the repairs could cost more than one million dollars.
exercises.upgrade: According to one estimate, the repairs could cost more than one million dollars.

options.explanation: by one estimate 是自然固定結構。

exercises.original: According to official figures, unemployment fell slightly last month.
exercises.upgrade: According to official figures, unemployment fell slightly last month.

options.explanation: 可在較壓縮的正式語體中表示依官方數字計算／判斷。
若有具體表格也可，但此處目標是簡潔來源標示。

words.note: 用來直接或接近直接地引用某人的表達。
words.example: In the words of the director, the project was “a major turning point.”
words.exampleZh: 用主管的話說，這個項目是「一個重大轉折點」。

exercises.original: According to the director, the project was “a major turning point.”
exercises.upgrade: According to the director, the project was “a major turning point.”

exercises.original: According to the author, the novel is “a story about memory and loss.”
exercises.upgrade: According to the author, the novel is “a story about memory and loss.”

words.note: 在商業、行政、技術或法律語境中可表示「根據／依照」。
words.example: Per company policy, all visitors must sign in at reception.
words.exampleZh: 按照公司政策，所有訪客都必須在接待處登記。

exercises.original: According to company policy, all expense claims require a receipt.
exercises.upgrade: According to company policy, all expense claims require a receipt.

options.explanation: 辦公／行政語體中非常精簡。

exercises.original: According to the instructions, the device should remain connected during the update.
exercises.upgrade: According to the instructions, the device should remain connected during the update.

falseSynonyms.zh: 因為不等於根據 because of 表示原因；according to 表示資訊來源或依據。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Because of the rain, the match was cancelled. According to the forecast, it will rain tomorrow.

falseSynonyms.zh: 由於不等於根據 due to 表示原因，不是資訊來源。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The delay was due to traffic. According to the report, traffic caused the delay.

falseSynonyms.zh: 我的看法不等於根據來源 in my opinion 是說話者自己的觀點；according to 通常指外部來源。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON In my opinion, the plan is risky. According to the report, the plan carries significant risks.

falseSynonyms.zh: 看來不等於根據某來源 apparently 表示根據表面資訊或傳聞，看來如此，但不明確指出來源。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Apparently, the train is late. According to the station website, the train is delayed by 20 minutes.

falseSynonyms.zh: 據報不等於明確指出來源 reportedly 表示「據報」，但常不說明是哪個來源。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Reportedly, the company plans to expand. According to the company statement, it plans to open three new offices.

falseSynonyms.zh: 之後／依照不一定等於根據 following 可以表示「在……之後」或「遵循」，但不是所有 according to 都能改成 following。
字形相近，意思不同 - according to = 根據／按照 - accordingly = 因此；相應地 - accord = 一致／協議
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON According to the rules, entry is restricted. The rules changed; accordingly, the procedure was updated.

falseSynonyms.zh: 名詞與介詞短語不同 source 是「來源」；according to 用來引出來源。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The report is the source. According to the report, demand increased.
